title: The certainty predicate endedWithoutUncertainty lacked the is prefix of the other boolean predicates
resolution: Renamed to isCertainEnd in the domain, its caller isSafeToRetry, and the change records.

title: The exit classification function exitVerdict was named as a noun
resolution: Renamed to classifyExit; the ExitVerdict type keeps its name.

title: The predicate comment and the design called an operator-resolved outcome uncertain
resolution: The comment says such an end is not certain enough for an automatic retry, and the design says the same of operator-resolved.

title: The requirement named a known status without the exit code or signal that the contract names
resolution: The requirement says a known status (exit code or signal), 499 characters, and strict validation after a scratch archive passes.
